summary: Action plugins that run modules should pass fully-qualified module names such as ansible.builtin.file to _execute_module() so the task's collection search order cannot pick an unintended module.
questions: Why should my action plugin call ansible.builtin.file instead of file?
How do I stop an action plugin from running a module from another collection?

answer_card.title: Use FQCNs in _execute_module()
answer_card.answer_md:
In action plugins, call modules by **FQCN**:

```python
self._execute_module(module_name='ansible.builtin.file', module_args=args, task_vars=task_vars)
```

Short names go through the task's collection search order, so a same-named module from another collection could run instead.
